en.title: Nondiscrimination Notice and Language Assistance
en.effective: Draft — effective date to be set by the practice

blocks.text: Our commitment

1234 Ortho-K Vision Care complies with applicable federal civil rights laws. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, national origin, age, disability or sex. We do not exclude people or treat them differently because of race, color, national origin, age, disability or sex.
Free help for people with disabilities
We provide free aids and services to people with disabilities so they can communicate with us effectively, such as:
Qualified sign language interpreters
Written information in other formats, such as large print, audio or accessible electronic formats
Free language services
We provide free language services to people whose primary language is not English, such as:
Qualified interpreters
Information written in other languages
How to get these services

If you need any of these services, please call our office at (626) 282-5388 or toll-free at (800) 991-8881. If you are deaf or hard of hearing, you can reach us through the California Relay Service by dialing 711.
How to file a grievance with us

If you believe that we have failed to provide these services or discriminated against you in another way on the basis of race, color, national origin, age, disability or sex, you can file a grievance with our Privacy Officer:
Privacy Officer, 1234 Ortho-K Vision Care
Mail or in person: 1234 S. Garfield Ave. #105, Alhambra, CA 91801
You can file a grievance in person, by mail or by phone. If you need help filing a grievance, our Privacy Officer is available to help you.
How to file a civil rights complaint with the federal government
You can also file a civil rights complaint with the U.S. Department of Health and Human Services, Office for Civil Rights:
Online: https://ocrportal.hhs.gov/ocr/portal/lobby.jsf
Mail: U.S. Department of Health and Human Services, 200 Independence Avenue, SW, Room 509F, HHH Building, Washington, D.C. 20201
Complaint forms are available at https://www.hhs.gov/ocr/office/file/index.html.
Language assistance
ATENCIÓN: si habla español, tiene a su disposición servicios gratuitos de asistencia lingüística. Llame al (626) 282-5388.
注意：如果您使用繁體中文，您可以免費獲得語言協助服務。請致電 (626) 282-5388。
注意：如果您使用简体中文，您可以免费获得语言协助服务。请致电 (626) 282-5388。
주의: 한국어를 사용하시는 경우, 언어 지원 서비스를 무료로 이용하실 수 있습니다. (626) 282-5388 번으로 전화해 주십시오.
CHÚ Ý: Nếu bạn nói Tiếng Việt, có các dịch vụ hỗ trợ ngôn ngữ miễn phí dành cho bạn. Gọi số (626) 282-5388.
PAUNAWA: Kung nagsasalita ka ng Tagalog, maaari kang gumamit ng mga serbisyo ng tulong sa wika nang walang bayad. Tumawag sa (626) 282-5388.
ՈՒՇԱԴՐՈՒԹՅՈՒՆ՝ Եթե խոսում եք հայերեն, ապա ձեզ անվճար կարող են տրամադրվել լեզվական աջակցության ծառայություններ։ Զանգահարեք (626) 282-5388։
注意事項：日本語を話される場合、無料の言語支援をご利用いただけます。(626) 282-5388 までお電話ください。

blocks.text: 我們的承諾
1234兒童視力矯正中心遵守適用的聯邦民權法律，不會因種族、膚色、原國籍、年齡、身心障礙或性別而歧視任何人，也不會因上述原因排斥任何人或給予差別待遇。
身心障礙人士的免費協助
我們免費為身心障礙人士提供輔助工具與服務，協助他們與我們順利溝通，例如：
合格的手語翻譯員
其他格式的書面資料，例如大字版、有聲版或無障礙電子檔
免費語言服務
對於主要語言不是英語的人士，我們免費提供語言服務，例如：
合格的口譯員
以其他語言撰寫的資料
如何取得這些服務
如需上述任何服務，請致電本中心 (626) 282-5388，或撥打免付費電話 (800) 991-8881。聽障或聽力不佳的人士，可撥打 711 透過加州轉接服務（California Relay Service）與我們聯繫。
如何向本中心提出申訴
如果您認為本中心未提供上述服務，或以其他方式因種族、膚色、原國籍、年齡、身心障礙或性別而歧視您，您可以向我們的隱私權專員提出申訴：
1234兒童視力矯正中心 隱私權專員（Privacy Officer）
郵寄或親自送達：1234 S. Garfield Ave. #105, Alhambra, CA 91801
您可以親自、以郵寄或透過電話提出申訴。如果您在提出申訴時需要協助，隱私權專員可以幫忙。
如何向聯邦政府提出民權投訴
您也可以向美國衛生及公共服務部民權辦公室（U.S. Department of Health and Human Services, Office for Civil Rights）提出民權投訴：
線上投訴：https://ocrportal.hhs.gov/ocr/portal/lobby.jsf
郵寄：U.S. Department of Health and Human Services, 200 Independence Avenue, SW, Room 509F, HHH Building, Washington, D.C. 20201
投訴表格可在 https://www.hhs.gov/ocr/office/file/index.html 取得。

PAUNAWA: Kung nagsasalita ka ng Tagalog, maaari kang gumamit ng mga serbisyo ng tulong sa wika nang walang bayad. Tumawag sa (626) 282-5388.

我们免费为残障人士提供辅助工具和服务，帮助他们与我们顺畅沟通，例如：
合格的手语翻译

免费语言服务
对于母语不是英语的人士，我们免费提供语言服务，例如：
合格的口译员
用其他语言编写的资料

1234儿童视力矫正中心 隐私官（Privacy Officer）
